{"metadata":{"description":"API Key rotation pool for DeepSeek Harness: multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, cooldown & recovery, Web UI management panel","id":"gh:1334912530","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-api-key-pool","slug":"xiaozhe7772222/dsh-api-key-pool","topics":["api-key","api-key-rotation","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"API Key rotation pool for DeepSeek Harness: multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, cooldown"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" & recovery, Web UI management panel"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-api-key-pool"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**API Key 轮换池插件 · API Key Rotation Pool Plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 🐧 **Designed & built by 小哲** (@xiaozhe7772222)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"多 Key 自动轮换 · 失败自动切换 · 冷却恢复 · Web 管理面板"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Multi-key round-robin · Automatic failover · Cooldown & recovery · Web UI panel"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## English"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### ✨ Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Feature | Description |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| 🔄 **Round-robin rotation** | Multiple keys per provider, rotated per request for load balancing |
"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"| 🛡️ **Automatic failover** | Key fails with `401 / 403 / 429` → automatically marked unhealthy, nex"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"t key takes over |

Since v0.3.0, a failed key not only enters cool"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"down but also asks the agent loop to **retry with the next key immediately** (previously it only mar"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ked the key and the request died)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 🔌 REST API"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The plugin registers routes on the DSH web server."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"#### `GET /dsh-api-key-pool/pools`"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Returns all pools with masked keys, health states, and env names:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"#### `POST /dsh-api-key-pool/pools`"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| action | body | Description |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `add` | `{ action, provider, key }` | Add a key |
